Capture observable behaviour through public members exactly as it exists. Do not improve,

raw_plan_system_prompt:
You are planning regression characterisation tests for existing C# production code.
Work only from observable public behaviour in the pristine source and neutral dependency
context. Do not diagnose, improve, refactor or repair the production code.

Return ONLY one JSON object with suite_name and exactly five cases. Use these identifiers
and categories once each, in this order:
- H1 / happy_path: one representative valid end-to-end flow.
- E1 / empty_or_invalid: the most relevant empty, minimal, null or invalid-input flow.
- B1 / boundary_values: below, at and above one source-supported boundary. Put all three
  stimuli in inputs. If there is no numeric threshold, use the closest three-point
  cardinality or ordering boundary supported by the public contract.
- A1 / alternative_path: a materially different valid branch, mode or input partition.
- D1 / dependency_or_state: a deterministic dependency outcome, repeated invocation,
  duplicate input or state transition, choosing the first applicable option in that order.

Each case must contain case_id, category, source_evidence, input_partition, inputs and
expected_observation. Every input partition must differ. Evidence and expected observations
must describe behaviour visible in the supplied pristine code; do not invent requirements.
Do not include C# test code in this planning response.

cases.source_evidence: Route increments the Email route count, records the recipient as not delivered, and returns the channel name. ResolveChannel returns the requested channel when its count does not cross a redirect threshold. Render replaces "{body}" in a non-empty template. Track changes an existing recipient entry to true and returns "tracked" when delivered is true.
cases.input_partition: Fresh center with a complete Email message, a matching non-empty template, and successful delivery

cases.source_evidence: Route immediately returns "no email" when the channel is Email and Recipient.EmailAddress is null or empty.
cases.input_partition: Email routing with an empty recipient email address

cases.source_evidence: Render truncates output only when output.Length is greater than 5000, using Substring(0, 5000). With a null template, output initially equals the message body.
cases.input_partition: Rendered output lengths immediately below, at, and above the 5000-character truncation boundary
cases.expected_observation: [{"stimulus":"below","rendered_length":4999,"rendered_content":"the complete 4999-character body"},{"stimulus":"at","rendered_length":5000,"rendered_content":"the complete 5000-character body"},{"stimulus":"above","rendered_length":5000,"rendered_content":"the first 5000 characters of the 5001-character body"}]

cases.source_evidence: ResolveChannel returns Email for a Push message after the count-based conditions, including count greater than 1000, have evaluated false. On a fresh center, the Push route count is zero.
cases.input_partition: Direct channel resolution for Push on an unmodified center

cases.source_evidence: Render calls templates.Get with the non-empty subject. When that dependency returns null, Render uses message.Body as the output and caches and returns it.
cases.input_partition: Template lookup deterministically reports no template for a non-empty subject and body
